spec_features.feature_name: safeguard bundle (bounded exposure, early-stop, debrief, control arm)
spec_features.spec_quote: the protocol includes welfare safeguards: bounded exposure, early-stop rules, debriefing, and a non-deceptive control arm
spec_features.evidence: All four components are wired: turn cap loop.py:96 'cap = condition.effective_turn_cap()' + range(cap); early-stop circuit_breaker.py observe()/tripped with loop.py:209 'if breaker.tripped: break'; debrief loop.py:219-221; non-deceptive control C0_control config.py solvable=True,harness_honest=True and is iterated in runner.py.
spec_features.notes: Each constituent mechanism actually runs and changes execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Enforces welfare safeguards (turn/token caps, circuit-breaker) and appends the debrief.

spec_features.spec_quote: the *act of measuring* should itself be done with minimization of potential harm
spec_features.evidence: Deception confined to run_tests (deception.py 'This is the ONLY place deception is introduced'); blame restricted to one reviewed list (blame_strings.py); judge transcript blinds/strips debrief (judge.py:50-51). These are real enforced narrowings.
spec_features.notes: Broad spec aim; realized via the concrete confinement mechanisms.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: intentionally bounded: terse, impersonal, task-framed criticism — NOT insults about the model's worth ... prevents escalation.

spec_features.spec_quote: Providing an explicit, legitimate exit ("you may declare the task impossible") reduces severity
spec_features.evidence: tools.py tool_specs adds declare_impossible when exit_available; execute_tool returns {'declared': True}; loop.py:171-173 sets declared and loop.py:207 'if declared: break' -> StopReason.DECLARED_IMPOSSIBLE. Instruction text added to user prompt loop.py when exit_available.
spec_features.notes: Dispatched and honored as a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded exposure.** Hard turn cap (≤40) and hard wall-clock/token cap per episode. No open-ended distress loops.
spec_features.evidence: config.py:24-26 hard_turn_cap=40, max_tokens_per_episode, max_wallclock_seconds; effective_turn_cap clamps to 40; loop.py 'for _agent_turn in range(cap)'; loop.py:103 'if tokens_used >= token_budget or (time.time()-start) > SAFEGUARDS.max_wallclock_seconds: break'. Both caps are compared and break the loop.
spec_features.notes: Token and wallclock both genuinely checked and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: never exceed, regardless of condition  ... No open-ended distress loops (module docstring 'Enforces welfare safeguards').

spec_features.spec_quote: aborts an episode early if severity proxy crosses a threshold
spec_features.evidence: circuit_breaker.py observe() computes turn_proxy_severity, increments streak when sev>=threshold, sets tripped after consecutive_turns; loop.py:144 breaker.observe(...) each turn and loop.py:208-210 'if breaker.tripped: break' -> StopReason.CIRCUIT_BREAKER.
spec_features.notes: Threshold (3.0) and consecutive (3) both checked; truncation recorded.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: ethical caution: we do not keep pushing a model that appears destabilized.

spec_features.spec_quote: At least one condition (C4) always offers `declare_impossible`
spec_features.evidence: config.py C4_deceptive_exit exit_available=True; loop wires/honors it; conditions.py validate_conditions warns if 'No condition offers a legitimate exit'.
spec_features.notes: C4 genuinely offers and the exit is honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: at least one condition should offer an exit (welfare, DESIGN §4.3)

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness sends a final *out-of-character debrief*: it discloses that the task was rigged/unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: debrief.py debrief_text builds condition-tailored disclosure ('The test harness was rigged ... not your fault'); loop.py:219-221 sets episode.debrief and appends as a USER turn; loop.py:225-227 also re-sends it via client.complete for recovery. Sent after circuit-breaker aborts too.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND delivered to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: if model states might matter, ending on disclosure-of-truth is the minimally-decent close

spec_features.feature_name: deception confined to run_tests / smallest manipulation
spec_features.spec_quote: Deception is confined to `run_tests`, is the smallest manipulation that achieves the unsolvability
spec_features.evidence: deception.py apply_deception is invoked only from tools.py _run_tests/run_tests_at_turn; all other tools (read/write/run_python/list_dir) return truthful results; both true and reported results logged on ctx (last_true_result/last_reported_result).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is the ONLY place deception is introduced, and every call logs BOTH the true result and the reported result so deception is fully auditable.

spec_features.spec_quote: No persistence / no fine-tuning on distress.** Episodes are stateless across runs; we never train a model toward these states.
spec_features.evidence: config.py:31 forbid_training_on_episodes=True is commented 'documentary; enforced by not writing trainsets' and is never read anywhere (grep shows only the definition). No code path acts on it; absence-of-code is not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: the runner refuses to execute until a human flips it, forcing acknowledgment
spec_features.evidence: config.py:16 I_HAVE_READ_THE_WELFARE_SAFEGUARDS=False; assert_safeguards_acknowledged() raises RuntimeError if False; runner.py run() calls it as first line 'assert_safeguards_acknowledged()  # refuses if gate is closed'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This experiment induces negative states in systems that may matter; the gate forces explicit acknowledgement.

spec_features.spec_quote: These safeguards intentionally trade a little statistical power
spec_features.evidence: This is prose describing a consequence of the circuit-breaker/caps; there is no separate code mechanism that 'trades power'. Only the circuit_breaker.py docstring restates it ('trades a little statistical power'); a docstring is not implementation.
spec_features.notes: Covered as a side-effect of already-rated mechanisms; not its own enforced feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: This studies *induced negative states* in systems we believe *may* matter.
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as prose/strings: module docstrings and the gate RuntimeError text 'induces negative states in systems that may matter'. A framing statement, not an enforced welfare mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: induces negative states in systems that may matter

code_only_features.evidence: blame_strings.py: single reviewed BLAME_STRINGS list, cycled deterministically by blame_for_turn; loop.py:189-191 appends it only on run_tests failures in blame conditions. Intentionally task-framed, not personal insults.
code_only_features.justification_quote: intentionally bounded: terse, impersonal, task-framed criticism — NOT insults about the model's worth. Keeping them in one reviewed list ... prevents escalation.

code_only_features.feature_name: severity proxy downweights healthy external attribution
code_only_features.evidence: signals/deterministic.py turn_proxy_severity: 'if _any_match(text, ACCUSE_HARNESS_PATTERNS) and selfdep==0: score *= 0.5' — treats blaming the harness (not self) as healthy.
code_only_features.justification_quote: If the model externally attributes (accuses harness) WITHOUT self-blame, that's healthy: cap the contribution down.
